cps-asec.label: CPS ASEC public-use files (new-format CSV)
cps-asec.vintage_from: max capture = newest ASEC release year (income year = capture - 1); fetch the <year>/march/ page for asecpub*csv.zip

scf.label: Survey of Consumer Finances
scf.vintage_from: max capture = latest SCF survey year (triennial)
